page.content:
Silver-masked arms dealer who supplies Cobra and answers to M.A.R.S.

How Destro connects

  • Faction: M.A.R.S. — Destro heads the M.A.R.S. arms company.
  • Faction: Cobra — Destro arms Cobra through M.A.R.S. while remaining a client, not a trooper.
  • Creator: The Baroness — The Baroness and Destro are Cobra's most durable officer pairing.

What is Destro?

Destro is James McCullen Destro XXIV, the Scottish weapons merchant whose chrome mask and M.A.R.S. company arm Cobra while he treats Cobra Commander as a client, not a master.

Key threads lead to M.A.R.S., Cobra and The Baroness.
